in_sanskrit.name: अवधेश
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of prosperity, God of power and God of the earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows prosperity, the one who has the power to rule, and the one who is the lord of the earth.

in_hindi.name: अवधेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिसका दिक प्रकाश होता है, जिसका शक्ति होता है और जिसका पृथ्वी पति है।

in_tamil.name: அவதேஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: வருப்பட்ட அளவு (The one who has come), விருப்பம் (The one who has power), மரணம் (The one who is the lord of death).

in_telugu.name: అవదేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: ప్రభావ (The one who has arrived), శక్తి (The one who has power), పృథ్య్వీ పతి (The one who is the lord of the earth).

in_marathi.name: Avdhesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avdhesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avdhesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अवधेश’, which means ‘the lord of prosperity’. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring wealth, success, and abundance in one's life.
